mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) may potentiate estrogenic/progestogenic effects and increase hypertensive risk through sympathomimetic potentiation; levonorgestrel may theoretically affect MAOI metabolism via hepatic enzyme induction.
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly and counsel on signs of hypertensive crisis; consider alternative contraception or antidepressant if clinically feasible; ensure adequate dietary restrictions during MAOI therapy.
